analysis.missing: Missing metrics/tokens/cost are null (blank CSV cells), not zero.
analysis.repetition_rubric: Repeated unsuccessful approach = same approach category and exact case-folded, whitespace-normalized proposed change after an earlier rejection. No semantic inference.
analysis.retained_curve: Last observed accepted-code latency; carried values are explicit, not independent remeasurements. Incomplete runs are not extrapolated.
analysis.uncertainty: Sample SD/range across independent runs, never across iterations. Descriptive only; no significance claim.

note: Speedup = first arm's final latency / second arm's (>1 means the second arm is faster). Descriptive only; complete runs only.
